===== 12-Day Voyageurs (ages 13-16)  (https://www.ymcaquebec.org/en/summer-camp-kanawana/voyageurs) =====
Home
Camps
Discover Kanawana
12-Day Voyageurs (Ages 13-16)
12-Day Voyageurs
Campers enjoy an
immersive canoe-tripping experience
, including an
eight-day trip through Québec’s natural landscapes
.
After preparing at Camp YMCA Kanawana, they take an active role in every aspect of the trip, from navigation and portaging to everyday tasks.
Led by experienced guides, campers develop their canoeing and outdoor skills, independence, team spirit and leadership throughout the adventure.
2027 registration
Ages :
13 to 16
Gender:
mixed
Registration for the 2027 season at YMCA Kanawana Camp is about to open!
Fill out the interest form
Previous element
Next element
How to register
Only available during registration period.
Step 1:
Click on the "Register your child" button
Step 2:
Once you have chosen the age-appropriate program for your child, create or log in to your account on Active, our registration and payment platform, and add your child's profile to your account.
Step 3:
Complete the transaction on Active.
If you need help, please write to us using our
contact form
or call us at
514-687-9622
, ext. 1524 (Montréal) or
1-833-505-9622, ext. 1524
(outside Montréal).
Opening hours
Monday - Friday* :
8 a.m. - 7 p.m.
Saturday* : 9 a.m. - 4 p.m.
Sunday* : 10 a.m. - 4 p.m.
View the itinerary
Our address
673 Saint-Elmire Street
Saint-Sauveur-des-Monts, QC, J0R 1R1
Phone numbers
1 833 505-9622
514 687-9622
Email
camp.kanawana@ymcaquebec.org
*Opening hours of the Contact Centre
Additional information
Learn more about the program
All campers are encouraged to participate and contribute according to their strengths and skills, whether it is by collecting firewood, portaging a canoe, or navigating the way. They will swim, paddle, and explore while learning basic survival and leadership skills as well as canoe safety and water hydrology. Campers also benefit from experiential educational activities to help them better understand, appreciate, and preserve the natural environment.
Campers spend time at camp preparing for their canoe trip, as well as debriefing their trip upon their return.
Please note:
For safety purposes, Camp YMCA Kanawana reserves the right to change the length and locations of each trip. These will be determined depending on weather, water, and road conditions, as well as the overall schedule of trips each session.
A typical day at camp YMCA Kanawana
This is a typical day on a canoe-tripping expedition:
7 a.m.: wake-up
7:30 a.m.: participation in tasks that will also need to be done on the trip, such as gathering firewood and making breakfast
9 a.m.: take down tents and camp site and help pack canoes
10:30 a.m.: paddle
11:30 a.m.: canoe games and rest
12:30 p.m.: lunch on the beach
2 p.m.: paddle to camp site
3 p.m.: put up tents and swimming by camp site
4 p.m.: survival program activity
5:30 p.m.: dinner preparation and participation in trip tasks
7:30 p.m.: stories around the campfire
9 p.m.: teeth brushing and sweet dreams
Please note that this is a generic schedule that will be adapted to each program by our trip guides according to the group's itinerary.
Lights out time also varies depending on the daily activities and the age of the campers.
Our schedule and programming is subject to change.
Financial assistance
All young people should have the opportunity to experience the magic of camp, regardless of their financial situation.
That is why our
financial assistance program
can cover part of the cost if you are unable to pay the full amount.
Tax credits
Some fees are eligible for tax credits for
child care expense
and children’s physical activities. If you would like to receive the tax credit for child care expenses
by advance payments
, please consult the
detailed procedure
on the Revenu Québec website before contacting us. Certain conditions apply.
Terms and conditions
Consult our
terms and conditions
to learn about our refund policies, Camp YMCA Kanawana registration modifications, as well as the general terms and conditions you agree to when you register your child for camp.

Next element

Camp YMCA Kanawana offers a gorgeous natural setting.

===== 19-Day Voyageurs Extreme (ages 14-17)  (https://www.ymcaquebec.org/en/summer-camp-kanawana/voyageurs-extreme) =====
Home
Camps
Discover Kanawana
19-Day Voyageurs Extreme (Ages 14–17)
19-Day Voyageurs Extreme
Campers enjoy an
immersive canoe-tripping experience
that allows them to gradually develop their canoe-trip and whitewater skills.
After an initial four-day trip, they take part in preparing and planning a 12-day adventure on a river in Québec or Ontario.
Navigation, portaging, community living and wilderness challenges help them strengthen their independence, team spirit and leadership skills throughout the experience.
Learn more about the program

Additional information
Learn more about the program
All campers are encouraged to participate and contribute according to their strengths and skills, whether it is by collecting firewood, portaging a canoe, or navigating the way. They will swim, paddle, and explore while learning basic survival and leadership skills as well as canoe safety and water hydrology. Campers also benefit from experiential educational activities to help them better understand, appreciate, and preserve the natural environment.
Campers spend time at camp preparing for their canoe trip, as well as debriefing their trip upon their return.
Please note: For safety purposes, Camp YMCA Kanawana reserves the right to change the length and locations of each trip. These will be determined depending on weather, water, and road conditions, as well as the overall schedule of trips each session.
Canoe trips are physically demanding and require a certain level of swimming ability. Kanawana therefore reserves the right to refuse any participant we deem unable to cope with the demands of such a trip.
* If your child is gender non-conforming or transgender, please let us know so that we can ensure that they are comfortable with their cabin arrangement.

3 p.m.: put up tents and swimming by camp site
4 p.m.: survival program activity
5:30 p.m.: dinner preparation and participation in trip tasks
7:30 p.m.: stories around the campfire
9 p.m.: teeth brushing and sweet dreams

===== 26-Day Voyageurs Ultimate (ages 15-17)  (https://www.ymcaquebec.org/en/summer-camp-kanawana/voyageurs-ultimate) =====
Home
Camps
Discover Kanawana
26-Day Voyageurs Ultimate (Ages 15 to 17)
26-Day Voyageurs Ultimate
Participants aged 15 to 17 enjoy an immersive experience combining wilderness adventure, leadership and technical skills development.
At the heart of the program is a 19-day whitewater canoe expedition, during which they take part in trip planning, take on new challenges and gradually put their skills into practice.
The experience is designed to develop their independence, confidence and teamwork while preparing them to progress to Kanawana’s leadership programs.
Learn more about the program
2027 registration
Ages:
15 to 17
Gender:
mixed

apply for a leadership program

Additional information
Learn more about the program
Participants in our Voyageurs Ultimate program will have the opportunity to plan and lead with their peers on a 18- to 22-day white water canoe trip. They will leave with transferrable leadership and technical skills that can be brought into all aspects of their lives and will gain the confidence in their survival and canoe-trip skills.
Participants can enjoy all aspects of trip planning and preparation, and experience co-leading during 2 days of the trip to practise the hard and soft skills they are developing throughout. They will get to plan their own menu, route and learn about hydrology, campsite management and survival and interpretation skills.
Campers can only register in one session: Voyageurs Ultimate (sessions 3 and 4)
All our canoe trips are centred on teamwork and community living while helping participants develop their leadership and outdoor survival skills.
A typical day at camp
This is a typical day on a canoe-tripping expedition:
7 a.m.: wake-up
7:30 a.m.: participation in tasks that will also need to be done on the trip, such as gathering firewood and making breakfast
9 a.m.: take down tents and camp site and help pack canoes
10:30 a.m.: paddle
11:30 a.m.: canoe games and rest
12:30 p.m.: lunch on the beach
2 p.m.: paddle to camp site
3 p.m.: put up tents and swimming by camp site
4 p.m.: survival program activity
5:30 p.m.: dinner preparation and participation in trip tasks
7:30 p.m.: stories around the campfire
9 p.m.: teeth brushing and sweet dreams
Please note that this is a generic schedule that will be adapted to each program by our trip guides according to the group's itinerary.
Our facilities
Nestled in the heart of the Laurentians, just 45 minutes from Montréal, Camp YMCA Kanawana offers a gorgeous natural setting and
a wide range of facilities
for a memorable stay in the great outdoors.

===== 24-Day Rangers (ages 15-16)  (https://www.ymcaquebec.org/en/summer-camp-kanawana/rangers) =====
Home
Camps
Discover Kanawana
24-Day Rangers (Ages 15-16)
24-Day Rangers
Participants gain their first hands-on
leadership experience at Camp YMCA
Kanawana
by taking an active role in camp life and programming.
Throughout the 24-day program, they develop their independence, sense of responsibility and activity leadership skills while putting what they learn into practice by working with camp groups.
The program also includes training leading to a DAFA certificate and serves as a stepping stone to
Kanawana’s
more advanced leadership programs.
2027 Registration
Ages:
15 to 16
Gender:
mixed

Additional information
A typical day at camp
A wide range of activities every day.
8:00 a.m. - 9:00 a.m.: Breakfast and announcements
9:00 a.m. - 9:20 a.m.:  Cabin clean-up & preparation for the day
9:20 a.m. - 10:25 a.m.:  Cabin/tent program #1
10:25 a.m. - 11:30 a.m.:  Cabin/tent program #2
11:30 a.m. - 12:15 p.m.: General swim and open program areas * (canoe, archery and nature activities)
12:15 p.m. - 12:30 p.m.: Prepare for lunch
12:30 p.m. - 1:30 p.m.: Lunch and announcements, plus section cheers every few days
1:30 p.m. - 2:30 p.m.: Siesta/break time
2:30 p.m. - 3:30 p.m.: Interest group #1
3:30 p.m. - 4:30 p.m.: Interest group #2
4:30 p.m. - 5:30 p.m.: General swim and open program areas *
5:30 p.m. - 5:45 p.m.: Prepare for dinner
5:45 p.m. - 6:45 p.m.: Dinner and announcements
6:45 p.m. - 7:00 p.m.: Down time, no programming
7:00 p.m. - 8:00 p.m.: Cabin/tent program #3
8:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m.: Cabin/tent program #4 (junior campers prepare for bed)
9:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m.: Campfire (senior campers prepare for bed)
10:00 p.m.: Lights out
* Open program areas vary depending on weather and availability of staff, but typically will change from morning to afternoon.
Please note: Some days include all-section or all-camp activities instead of interest group blocks or cabin/tent group programming.
Lights out time also varies depending on the daily activities and the age of the campers.
Our schedule and programming is subject to change.
Financial assistance
All young people should have the opportunity to experience the magic of camp, regardless of their financial situation. That is why our
financial assistance program
can cover part of the cost if you are unable to pay the full amount.

===== 48-Day Trailblazers Counsellor-in-Training (ages 16-17)  (https://www.ymcaquebec.org/en/summer-camp-kanawana/trailblazers-counsellor) =====
Home
Camps
Discover Kanawana
48-Day Trailblazers Counsellor-in-Training (Ages 16-17)
48-Day Trailblazers Counsellor-in-Training
Participants prepare to become camp counsellors through comprehensive training that combines learning, hands-on experience and leadership development.
Over the
48-day program, more than 200 hours of workshops and training
help them develop skills in activity leadership, communication, teamwork and risk management.
They then put what they have learned into practice while working with camp groups and take part in a five-day canoe trip, an experience that further develops their independence and leadership skills.
2027 Registration
Ages:
16 to 17
Gender:
mixed

48-Day Foresters Canoe Guides-in-training

===== 48-Day Foresters Canoe Guides-in-Training (ages 16-17)  (https://www.ymcaquebec.org/en/summer-camp-kanawana/foresters-canoe-guides) =====
Home
Camps
Discover Kanawana
48-Day Foresters Canoe Guides-in-training (Ages 16-17)
48-Day Foresters Canoe Guides-in-training
Participants receive advanced training that combines leadership development, outdoor skills and preparation for the role of a canoe trip guide.
Hands-on workshops and a canoe expedition consisting of 28 to 32 days of whitewater travel and four days of flatwater travel help them develop their technical skills, teamwork and confidence in a wilderness adventure setting.
Throughout the program, participants put what they learn into practice alongside the Kanawana team and gain hands-on experience in leading and preparing canoe trips.

16 to 17

Certifications
